main_text.l: LIBER AD EVNDEM ILLVSTREM ET GENEROSVM Do. Philippum Sydneium.
In te animi ista sui ponit monimenta Danæus,Qui tibi deuotus pectore semper erit.Tu cape, sed facili, Sydnei, munera vultu:Sint quamuis genio dona minora tuo.

page.notes: The title is set in mixed type: "LIBER AD EVNDEM" and "ILLVSTREM ET GENE-" in spaced capitals, "rosum" in italic with "Do." and "Philippum" in italic, "Sydneium" in italic. The word "GENE-" is hyphenated across the line to "rosum". Verse lines are set as one stanza; the line breaks are kept by the printed lines. The ornament at the top is a printer's band and is not transcribed.
